title: Bulk mode cannot be turned on while a cycle count is running
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active tracked part, part A, for this test, with 5 in its bin.
  • Make sure no Cycle count is running on the Inventory list.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  2. Click Cycle count.
  3. Click Cancel in the count toolbar.
  4. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮).
  5. Click Cycle count.
  6. Type 5 in part A's Count box.
  7. Click Save in the count toolbar.
  8. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The count starts: the toolbar shows the count controls (the printer icon, Save, Cancel and "Count changes available") and part A has a Count box.
  • The three-dot actions button is not shown while the count runs, so Deactivate parts cannot be reached, and no checkbox column appears.

Step 3:

  • The count ends without saving and the three-dot actions button is back.

Step 4:

  • The menu lists "Cycle count", "Deactivate parts" and "Export".

Step 5:

  • The count starts again and the three-dot actions button is not shown.

Step 6:

  • Part A's Count box shows 5.

Step 7:

  • The count is saved and ends; part A still shows 5 Available.

Step 8:

  • The menu is back with "Cycle count", "Deactivate parts" and "Export".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S2-E4: “Cycle count and bulk status mode cannot both be on. While Cycle count runs, the actions menu is replaced by the count controls, so the bulk status entry cannot be reached until the count is saved or discarded. While bulk status mode is on, the menu does not offer Cycle count (S2-R10b).”
